description: mcCalendar is a Power BI custom visual that displays your dataset as a weekly calendar, placing each row as an event using date and start/end time. It supports week navigation, event create/edit with validation, configurable week start and 12/24-hour time, and rich formatting and tooltip options from the Power BI formatting pane. For teams that manage schedules in Power BI—such as operations, staffing, project, or service management—it solves the pain of reading schedules in tables and manually re-entering changes elsewhere by providing a familiar calendar view and, optionally, API writeback to create, update, and delete events (including sending additional metadata fields).
